##### Project general facts

Peninsula Four - The Plaza is a landmark waterfront development by Select Group. This exceptional project features two striking towers and a collection of premium waterfront duplex lofts, offering an array of exquisitely finished studios and one, two, three, and four-bedroom units. Where the ultimate in style meets impeccable design, Peninsula Four provides a combination of sophistication and elegance with a contemporary urban twist, framed by spectacular views of Downtown Dubai landmarks including the Burj Khalifa and the glistening waters of the Dubai Canal.

Residents enjoy an exclusive array of onsite amenities designed to engage all senses. From lazing away sunny afternoons on the sundeck by the infinity lap pool, enjoying downtime in the sauna, to hitting the weights at the state-of-the-art gym or breaking a sweat at the squash courts, Peninsula Four has something for everyone. The Plaza features an extensive range of indoor and outdoor dining experiences, retail and entertainment facilities, along with generous areas of gardens and public realm. Each tower features a spectacular swimming pool, kids' pool, state-of-the-art gym, and sauna.

Every unit at Peninsula Four is tastefully designed to make optimum use of space and create flowing, open living spaces, enhanced by striking floor-to-ceiling windows that frame spectacular views. The lofts feature three and four-bedroom duplexes with lush interiors and thoughtfully designed living areas, perfectly tailored for family living. Kitchens are fully equipped with premium fittings including fridge/freezer, stainless steel sinks, oven, hob extract hood, and dishwasher. Each residence is meticulously designed for those who appreciate copious open spaces, with interiors that exude a timeless elegance that creates a superb feeling of space and light.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in the prime location of Business Bay, one of Dubai's most recognisable neighbourhoods, this exceptional location is well-connected and known for its cosmopolitan, fast-paced vibe. Boasting close proximity to the prestigious Downtown Dubai district, Dubai's Old Town, and Dubai Marina, it offers residents unrestricted access to the city's most recognisable landmarks.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning as an emerging oasis on the doorstep of Downtown. Peninsula is a master-planned waterfront community offering residents a unique blend of urban city living, prime locality, and an exclusive waterfront lifestyle. The area is quickly becoming full of life and ripe with opportunity for those wishing to invest in a truly dynamic part of Dubai.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, urban sophistication, and a prime Dubai address, Business Bay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live in the heart of it all — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
